name: Shaul
bio: Shaul, a son of Simeon and a Canaanite woman, was among the seventy members of Jacob's family who came into Egypt; he is a different figure from King Saul of Israel, from Saul of Rehoboth, a king of Edom, and from Saul of Tarsus, later known as the apostle Paul (Genesis 46:10, 27).
